features.name: lsat_normalized
features.description: LSAT score normalized to [0,1] range using training set min/max bounds (15 to 48)
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized score directly usable as linear SVM feature without scale distortion

features.name: ugpa_normalized
features.description: Undergraduate GPA normalized to [0,1] range using training set min/max bounds (1.6 to 4.0)
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized GPA score for linear margin computation

features.name: academic_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of normalized LSAT and UGPA scores, with LSAT weighted 0.6 and UGPA weighted 0.4
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite academic strength score useful for linear SVM decision boundary

features.name: decile_average
features.description: Average of decile1 and decile3 scores, normalized to [0,1] range
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous ranking measure combining two decile assessments for linear projection

features.name: decile_consistency
features.description: Inverse of absolute difference between decile1 and decile3, measuring consistency of academic ranking across two periods
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures consistency of academic performance; consistent high performers may differ from inconsistent ones

features.name: lsat_ugpa_interaction
features.description: Product of normalized LSAT and normalized UGPA, capturing joint academic strength
features.expected_model_benefit: Interaction term approximating nonlinear joint effect within linear SVM framework

features.name: bar_fulltime_score
features.description: Combined score of bar passage and full-time enrollment status; fulltime=1 maps to 1.0, fulltime=2 maps to 0.0
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures combined commitment and achievement signal useful for linear margin

features.name: fam_inc_normalized
features.description: Family income level normalized to [0,1] range (1 to 5 scale)
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth socioeconomic indicator for linear SVM without ordinal scale distortion

features.name: academic_socioeconomic_ratio
features.description: Ratio of academic composite to family income level, capturing academic achievement relative to socioeconomic background
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative academic overperformance given socioeconomic context, useful for linear decision boundary

features.name: cluster_academic_alignment
features.description: Numeric cluster value normalized to [0,1] combined with academic composite, measuring alignment between cluster assignment and academic performance
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines cluster grouping with academic performance for richer linear feature

features.name: overall_academic_strength
features.description: Holistic assessment of academic strength combining LSAT percentile standing, GPA quality, decile rankings, and bar passage into a single severity score from 0 (weakest) to 1 (strongest)
features.expected_model_benefit: Semantic composite capturing nuanced academic quality beyond individual metrics, providing smooth score for SVM margin

features.name: admission_risk_score
features.description: Semantic risk assessment score from 0 (low risk profile) to 1 (high risk profile) based on combination of below-average LSAT, low GPA, low decile rankings, part-time status, and low family income relative to academic demands
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures holistic risk profile as continuous score enabling linear SVM to use single interpretable risk dimension
